result.description: AI research search engine over 400M+ peer-reviewed papers, with a REST API and hosted MCP server.
result.auth_detail: REST API: per-user API key from the consensus.app API & MCP dashboard, sent in the x-api-key header. Hosted MCP server uses OAuth, where each user signs in with their own account. No OAuth for the REST API is documented.
result.access_detail: Every plan includes API access, and the Free plan has 30 calls a month. Paid plans offer 500 or 2,000 calls, plus Custom for Enterprise, at 1 req/s. Overage is $0.05 per call on paid plans. Keys are created self-serve in the dashboard. The API and MCP share one monthly pool. Full-text excerpts need a paid plan.
result.api_notes: Endpoints from the GitHub README: GET /v1/search (semantic paper search), POST /v1/threads, GET /v1/threads, GET /v1/threads/{thread_id} and POST /v1/threads/{thread_id}/interactions. /v1/quick_search is deprecated and will be removed on 2027-02-07. Base URL is https://api.consensus.app. I could not read the docs.consensus.app pages (HTTP 403), so this comes from the official GitHub README and search snippets.
result.blocker: The API is narrow: search plus threads only. The free tier is 30 calls a month. Key auth is per user, so a single OAuth flow for the REST API is not available. MCP OAuth uses DCR, and Composio-managed OAuth is reportedly unavailable. The docs pages returned 403 for me, so some limits are unverified.

evidence.quote: Authenticate every request with your key in the `x-api-key` header.
The Free plan includes 30 calls a month, so you can make a request in a couple of minutes.
